title: WIST Item (WIST-1)
description: A Publisher's current statement for one URL, of kind page or removed, with exactly the members of its kind (WIST-1 §3.3). An object that carries a member `removed` is of kind removed. Size-cap profiles follow WIST-1 section 3.6, Size-cap parameter time; this schema cannot select a validation-stage parameter map.

payload.description: Salted commitment to the Item's content (WIST-1 §3.6). The content itself travels as a Payload named by the Item ID (WIST-3 §6.1) and never enters the Log.

bytes.description: Octets of JCS(content) = extract_cap_bytes + summary_cap_bytes + links_cap_bytes + the 32 octets of {"extract":,"links":,"summary":} structure that surround them (WIST-1 §3.6). It is a derived bound, not an independent constant.

lang.description: Lexical language-tag profile under WIST-1 section 3.7; no registry lookup, subtag ordering or uniqueness checks.

oneOf.title: Item of kind removed
oneOf.description: A URL the Publisher no longer publishes, kept listed under the page's key (WIST-1 §3.3); it is not held to url_cap_bytes.

publisher.description: Publisher identity under WIST-1 section 3.8; must equal its own Canonical Host and the publisher of the Catalog that lists the Item. The pattern alone does not validate A-labels.

observed_at.description: WIST-1 section 3.4: Gregorian calendar validation, exact fractions and offsets, seconds 00–59 without leap-event data; year zero is valid. The pattern alone does not establish calendar validity.
